what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in the Dominican Republic whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 99484 people in this group in the Dominican Republic, 1.6% of all Venezuelans in it.
The largest numbers of Venezuelan refugees live in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR has counted this group only since 2018, when the figure was 26428.
It reached its highest point, 125343, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Dominican Republic.
These are year-end totals for the Dominican Republic only, and the group is never added to refugees.
